explication: Buttercup is a cyber reasoning system that discovers vulnerabilities in OSS-Fuzz-compatible projects and generates patches. Its documented principal workflow is task coordination, seed generation and fuzzing, vulnerability analysis, then patching; users can also monitor tasks through a web UI. The graph preserves documented components and sampled internal layers. Some subsystem links are documented only at README level; unsampled implementations and dynamic wiring are not inferred.
